Accumulated precipitation in the latest minute. kg/m2 is equivalent to mm.
Data is sent to the DMI from the rain gauge every 10 minutes, if it has rained within the 10 minute period. No data is sent, if it hasn't rained within the 10 minute period.

Therefore, data will be null, if it hasn't rained within the 10 minute period. If, however, it has rained within the 10 minute period, the minutes, where it has rained, will show, how much it has rained during each of the minutes in question, whereas the minutes, where it didn't rain will be shown as '0'.

catalog_notes: Values in this catalog are transcribed from the DMI documentation and are not supplied by the observation API.
The parameter catalog covers the full parameter list in the DMI documentation, including parameters not present at Odense Lufthavn.
Code descriptions are transcribed from the DMI documentation and are independent of any particular station or saved observation sample.
Review this catalog when DMI changes its documentation or adds parameters.
